# Model seats

Use gpt-6.1-sol for implementation and gpt-6-astra for review. Use the installed research-delegate role for evidence and mechanical checks.

| Role | Custom agent | Model and effort |
|---|---|---|
| Worker | `pave-init:orchestrate-worker` | `gpt-6.1-sol`, `xhigh` |
| DA | `pave-init:adversarial-investigator` | `gpt-6-astra`, `xhigh` |
| Evidence, Step 1 helpers | `pave-init:research-delegate` | The installed role's configured model and effort |

## Keep each role's model and effort

Use `spawn_agent` with the named `agent_type` and `fork_turns: "none"` to retain its model and effort. Count retained agents and research helpers against available capacity; reserve helper slots or investigate directly. A fresh agent does not imply a different provider identity or quota.
